# 知盈 iAssets

> 知盈 (iAssets) is an Apple app for household assets. It keeps accounts, investments, and liabilities in one view, with an optional AI assistant and family books. Everyday tracking and family member management are free; iCloud sync, shared family books, and live market data are Pro. The app is named 知盈 in mainland China and iAssets elsewhere.

Canonical: https://iassets.debuginn.com/

Language: en

## Product

- [Home](https://iassets.debuginn.com/): English homepage. Accounts, investments, and liabilities in one view.

- [Features](https://iassets.debuginn.com/#features): Net worth, investments, books, family sharing, and the AI asset assistant.

- [Pricing](https://iassets.debuginn.com/#pricing-compare): Free for multi-currency books and family members. Pro yearly or lifetime adds iCloud sync, shared family books, and live market data.

- [Download](https://iassets.debuginn.com/#download): Install from the App Store. Mainland China lists the app as 知盈.

## Languages

- [English](https://iassets.debuginn.com/): Default language.

- [简体中文](https://iassets.debuginn.com/zh/): Simplified Chinese homepage, branded 知盈.

- [繁體中文](https://iassets.debuginn.com/zh-hant/): Traditional Chinese homepage.

- [日本語](https://iassets.debuginn.com/ja/): Japanese homepage.

- [한국어](https://iassets.debuginn.com/ko/): Korean homepage.

## FAQ

- [FAQ](https://iassets.debuginn.com/#faqs): Free tier versus Pro, how the AI assistant uses a model you configure, local storage versus iCloud, and family management versus sharing.
